name: Divisibility
description: Find the number of k -divisible numbers on the segment [ a , b ] . In other words you need to find the number of such integer values x that a ≤ x ≤ b and x is divisible by k .
input_specification: The only line contains three space-separated integers k , a and b ( 1 ≤ k ≤ 10 18 ; - 10 18 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ 10 18 ).
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
